title: The Republican Identity Crisis Over the Iran War

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即便是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrellef.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特雷尔。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: From the moment President Trump barreled into American politics, one of his central messages that resonated most with voters
sentences.zh: 从特朗普总统闯入美国政坛的那一刻起，他最能引起选民共鸣的核心信息之一

sentences.en: was his promise to keep the country out of endless wars.
sentences.zh: 就是他承诺让国家远离无休止的战争。

sentences.en: But now, as the war in Iran enters its fourth week, leading figures on the right are questioning whether Trump may have gotten the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但现在，随着伊朗战争进入第四周，右翼的主要人物开始质疑特朗普是否让美国

sentences.en: into exactly the sort of complex and costly conflict he railed against for so long.
sentences.zh: 陷入了他长期以来一直抨击的那种复杂且代价高昂的冲突中。

sentences.en: Today, we talk to my colleague Robert Draper about Trump's political evolution on the question of war and the identity crisis it's caused for the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们采访了我的同事罗伯特·德雷珀，探讨特朗普在战争问题上的政治演变，以及这给共和党带来的身份危机。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月23日，星期一。

sentences.en: Okay, Robert, you cover the right, and you functioned for us here at The Daily as our guide, really, to all the complexities of Trump and his party.
sentences.zh: 好的，罗伯特，你负责报道右翼，在《每日新闻》这里，你实际上担任了我们的向导，带我们了解特朗普及其政党的所有复杂性。

sentences.en: And right now seems to be a moment of reckoning within that exact group over the war in Iran, specifically the justification for it
sentences.zh: 而现在似乎正是该群体内部针对伊朗战争进行清算的时刻，特别是关于战争的理由，

sentences.en: and whether Trump is explicitly violating a pact that he made with his base of not starting another war.
sentences.zh: 以及特朗普是否明确违反了他对选民基础做出的“不发动另一场战争”的承诺。

sentences.en: So, what is the level of tension that you're seeing right now inside the MAGA movement?
sentences.zh: 那么，你现在在“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动内部看到了什么程度的紧张局势？

sentences.en: It's really a mess.
sentences.zh: 确实是一团糟。

sentences.en: You have people who are still steadfast in their support for what the administration is doing.
sentences.zh: 有些人仍然坚定地支持政府正在做的事情。

sentences.en: There are an awful lot of people, however, and I'm talking not only about the right-wing influencer ecosystem, but also all the way down to voters who are saying,
sentences.zh: 然而，有相当多的人——我指的不仅是右翼意见领袖圈，还包括底层的选民——都在说：

sentences.en: is this what we voted for?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们投票选出来的吗？

sentences.en: We thought no wars.
sentences.zh: 我们以为不会有战争。

sentences.en: We thought America firSt.
sentences.zh: 我们以为是“美国优先”。

sentences.en: What are we doing over there?
sentences.zh: 我们在那边到底在干什么？

sentences.en: What's this about $200 billion that Trump now wants from Congress to appropriate?
sentences.zh: 特朗普现在要求国会拨款的2000亿美元是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Where was $200 billion when I wanted to buy a home?
sentences.zh: 我想买房的时候，这2000亿美元在哪儿呢？

sentences.en: It has really, really become a problematic matter for the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普政府来说，真的、真的已经成了一个棘手的问题。

sentences.en: What you're describing sounds like real anger, right?
sentences.zh: 你描述的听起来像是真正的愤怒，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, anger and disbelief.
sentences.zh: 是的，愤怒和怀疑。

sentences.en: An inability to square what is happening in Iran with what Trump said on the campaign trail and what Americans face as domestic challenges.
sentences.zh: 无法将伊朗正在发生的事情与特朗普在竞选期间的言论，以及美国人面临的国内挑战联系起来。

sentences.en: Okay, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: Let's go there.
sentences.zh: 我们深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: What's the origin of that disconnect, that disbelief?
sentences.zh: 这种脱节、这种怀疑的根源是什么？

sentences.en: So, we should go back to what I believe was the fourth Republican presidential primary debate in November of 2015.
sentences.zh: 我们应该回到我认为是2015年11月举行的第四场共和党总统初选辩论。

sentences.en: Look at Iraq.
sentences.zh: 看看伊拉克。

sentences.en: Look at the mess we have after spending $2 trillion, thousands of lives, wounded warriors all over the place who I love.
sentences.zh: 看看我们在花费了2万亿美元、牺牲了数千条生命、到处都是我所敬爱的伤残军人之后，留下的烂摊子。

sentences.en: Okay, all over.
sentences.zh: 没错，到处都是。

sentences.en: We have nothing.
sentences.zh: 我们一无所获。

sentences.en: And there, on that stage, Trump explicitly said that the Iraq war was no one's idea of a success, but instead was a tragic waste of American blood and treasure.
sentences.zh: 当时在舞台上，特朗普明确表示，伊拉克战争不是任何人心目中的成功，而是一场对美国鲜血和财富的悲剧性浪费。

sentences.en: And we have to get smart.
sentences.zh: 我们必须变得聪明起来。

sentences.en: We can't continue to be the policemen of the world.
sentences.zh: 我们不能继续做世界警察。

sentences.en: We owe $19 trillion.
sentences.zh: 我们欠债19万亿美元。

sentences.en: We have a country that's going to hell.
sentences.zh: 我们的国家正在走向地狱。

sentences.en: And differentiated himself from other candidates who had basically repeated Republican orthodoxy about the Iraq war.
sentences.zh: 他将自己与其他基本上重复共和党关于伊拉克战争正统观念的候选人区分了开来。

sentences.en: Donald is wrong on this.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德在这件事上错了。

sentences.en: He is absolutely wrong on this.
sentences.zh: 他在这件事上绝对错了。

sentences.en: We're not going to be the world's policemen, but we sure as heck better be the world's leader.
sentences.zh: 我们不会做世界警察，但我们最好还是做世界领袖。

sentences.en: Can you just talk for a moment, Robert, about how remarkable it was to hear Trump say this?
sentences.zh: 罗伯特，你能谈谈听到特朗普这么说有多么不同寻常吗？

sentences.en: I mean, this was a break from the orthodoxy of the Republican Party for decades, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这在几十年来打破了共和党的正统观念，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was understood that thou shalt not speak ill of a Republican president, George W.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍认为，不得说共和党总统乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush.
sentences.zh: 布什的坏话。

sentences.en: And so for an office seeker, a Republican office seeker, to stand up and say that this war was
sentences.zh: 所以，对于一个寻求公职的共和党人来说，站出来说这场战争

sentences.en: just an unambiguous screw-up and you're never going to see me do this kind of thing was really singular and, I think, memorable to voters throughout the campaign.
sentences.zh: 简直是一个毫无疑问的错误，而且你永远不会看到我做这种事，这确实是独一无二的，我认为，这让选民在整个竞选过程中记忆犹新。

sentences.en: Yeah, that was something Democrats were, of course, willing to say at that point, but not Republicans.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是民主党人当时当然愿意说的话，但共和党人不会。

sentences.en: No, that's right.
sentences.zh: 不，没错。

sentences.en: So for Trump to do that really, I think, you know, opened Republican voters up to the notion that, you know, we don't have to embrace a militaristic viewpoint the way hawks on our
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普能做到这一点，我认为，你知道，让共和党选民意识到，我们不必像我们党内

sentences.en: side of the aisle are constantly urging us to, particularly when we have seen what it's done to a whole generation of Americans.
sentences.zh: 鹰派不断敦促我们的那样去拥抱军国主义观点，特别是当我们已经看到它对整整一代美国人造成了什么影响时。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: It was kind of the first and biggest example of Trump saying the thing that everyone thought but was too afraid to say, and it really obviously tapped into something.
sentences.zh: 这算是特朗普说出每个人心里想但又不敢说的话的第一个也是最大的例子，它显然触动了某些东西。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it tapped into the notion that America's leaders were not to be trusted.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它触动了人们认为美国领导人不可信的观念。

sentences.en: And he was drawing a clear distinction between what he was saying about our troops and what he was saying about our leadership.
sentences.zh: 他在关于我们军队的言论和关于我们领导层的言论之间划清了界限。

sentences.en: He was saying, I love the troops.
sentences.zh: 他说，我爱军队。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It's terrible what's happened to veterans.
sentences.zh: 退伍军人的遭遇太可怕了。

sentences.en: They've been so mistreated.
sentences.zh: 他们受到了如此糟糕的对待。

sentences.en: And they've been mistreated by these really, really stupid leaders who, you know, can barely organize a one-car funeral, much less prosecute a war overseas.
sentences.zh: 他们被这些非常、非常愚蠢的领导人虐待，你知道，他们连一场单车葬礼都组织不好，更别说在海外发动战争了。

sentences.en: And when you look at the centrality of that message, both its resonance and how much he referred
sentences.zh: 当你审视这一信息的核心地位，既包括它的共鸣，也包括他在2016年竞选中提到它的频率，

sentences.en: to it in that 2016 campaign, I think it seemed to a lot of people that this was the foundational principle of America FirSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为在很多人看来，这似乎是“美国优先”的基本原则。

sentences.en: Along with tariffs and immigration, this non-interventionism was core to what Trump stood for, to what he was going to do.
sentences.zh: 除了关税和移民，这种不干涉主义是特朗普所代表的、他将要做的事情的核心。

sentences.en: That's right, because it seemed like a very literal interpretation of America First, which is we look inward.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为这看起来是对“美国优先”非常字面的解读，即我们向内看。

sentences.en: We take care of people at home.
sentences.zh: 我们照顾国内的人民。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, consider the outside world only when it suits us.
sentences.zh: 同时，只有在适合我们的时候才考虑外部世界。

sentences.en: But unless and until that happens, we take care of our folks at home.
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，我们照顾好国内的民众。

sentences.en: And we should point out, as you've said, Trump has been very consistent with this messaging throughout his political career.
sentences.zh: 我们应该指出，正如你所说，特朗普在他的整个政治生涯中一直非常坚持这种信息传递。

sentences.en: It wasn't just in his first campaign, right?
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是在他的第一次竞选中，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, this was something he said in 2024.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是他在2024年说过的话。

sentences.en: He was not going to start any wars.
sentences.zh: 他不会发动任何战争。

sentences.en: He was going to stop them.
sentences.zh: 他会阻止它们。

sentences.en: I mean, he realized, Natalie, that this was a winning message, that people really responded to it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，娜塔莉，他意识到这是一个制胜的信息，人们真的对此做出了回应。

sentences.en: We're tired of fighting.
sentences.zh: 我们厌倦了战斗。

sentences.en: I'm the only president in the last 84 years that didn't start a war.
sentences.zh: 我是过去84年来唯一没有发动战争的总统。

sentences.en: Remember Crooked Hillary?
sentences.zh: 还记得“狡诈的希拉里”吗？

sentences.en: And so he realized as well that he could target his political opponent as the person who will prosecute endless wars.
sentences.zh: 所以他也意识到，他可以把政治对手描绘成一个会发动无休止战争的人。

sentences.en: He said that about Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 他曾那样评价希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: He later said it about Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 后来他又那样评价卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: He said that she would get us into a war with Iran.
sentences.zh: 他说她会让我们卷入与伊朗的战争。

sentences.en: She would get us into a World War III guaranteed because she is too grossly incompetent to do the job.
sentences.zh: 她会保证让我们陷入第三次世界大战，因为她太无能了，无法胜任这份工作。

sentences.en: She's not going to be able to.
sentences.zh: 她做不到。

sentences.en: And Trump, by the end of the 2024 campaign, was saying, I'm the peace president.
sentences.zh: 到2024年竞选结束时，特朗普一直在说，我是和平总统。

sentences.en: I said, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，不，不。

sentences.en: My rhetoric is going to keep us out of wars.
sentences.zh: 我的言论会让我们远离战争。

sentences.en: There will be no endless wars under my administration.
sentences.zh: 在我的政府领导下，不会有无休止的战争。

sentences.en: I didn't take us to war in my first term.
sentences.zh: 我在第一任期内没有带我们走向战争。

sentences.en: I won't take us to war in my second term.
sentences.zh: 在第二任期内我也不会带我们走向战争。

sentences.en: You can count on it.
sentences.zh: 你可以指望这一点。

sentences.en: But the notion that Trump was the peace president, that we inferred that from the things that he had said about the Iraq war, I think proved to be really misguided.
sentences.zh: 但认为特朗普是和平总统，我们从他关于伊拉克战争的言论中推断出这一点，我认为事实证明是非常误导的。

sentences.en: I think that it was something that we fundamentally misunderstood about Trump and what you would call his ideology.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们对特朗普以及你所称的他的意识形态从根本上误解了的东西。

sentences.en: OK, explain that.
sentences.zh: 好的，解释一下。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that we tend to fall into the trap of assuming that when Trump is espousing
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为我们往往会陷入一种陷阱，即假设当特朗普在支持

sentences.en: something that it is an ideology, when the belief, in fact, that he is espousing is self-belief.
sentences.zh: 某件事时，那是一种意识形态，而实际上他所支持的信念是“自我信念”。

sentences.en: In other words, that he's not saying, here is a core principle of what we believe in.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他不是在说，这是我们信仰的核心原则。

sentences.en: Instead, he's saying, other people are doing it stupid.
sentences.zh: 相反，他是在说，别人做得太蠢了。

sentences.en: I'm going to do it smart.
sentences.zh: 我要做得聪明点。

sentences.en: And in fact, he was actually saying that in real time during that presidential debate that I referenced earlier.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他在我刚才提到的那场总统辩论中，实时地表达了这一点。

sentences.en: Back in 2015, you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是说2015年的时候？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, November 2015, when he says, you know, terrible war, tragic.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，2015年11月，他说，你知道，可怕的战争，悲剧。

sentences.en: And then he says right after that, and we should have kept the oil.
sentences.zh: 然后他紧接着说，我们本应该保留石油。

sentences.en: Believe me, we should have kept the oil.
sentences.zh: 相信我，我们本应该保留石油。

sentences.en: And we didn't take the oil.
sentences.zh: 我们没有拿走石油。

sentences.en: That's what we should have done.
sentences.zh: 那才是我们应该做的。

sentences.en: We should have taken the oil.
sentences.zh: 我们本应该拿走石油。

sentences.en: And then, in fact, the previous debate, he had actually said, I'm a very militaristic person.
sentences.zh: 而且事实上，在之前的辩论中，他实际上说过，我是一个非常崇尚军事的人。

sentences.en: I'm a very militaristic person.
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常崇尚军事的人。

sentences.en: It's about judgment.
sentences.zh: 这关乎判断力。

sentences.en: I didn't want to go into Iraq and I fought it.
sentences.zh: 我不想进入伊拉克，我反对它。

sentences.en: But you have to know when to use the military.
sentences.zh: 但你必须知道何时使用军队。

sentences.en: So there he was explicitly saying, I'm not an anti-war president.
sentences.zh: 所以他在那里明确表示，我不是一个反战总统。

sentences.en: I'm a smart war president is what I am.
sentences.zh: 我是一个聪明的战争总统，这就是我。

sentences.en: You're saying this wasn't actually a genuine, heartfelt rejection of foreign intervention, of using military power abroad.
sentences.zh: 你是说这实际上并不是对外国干预、对在海外使用军事力量的真诚、发自内心的拒绝。

sentences.en: That we might have interpreted it that way, but that wasn't necessarily what we were actually seeing.
sentences.zh: 我们可能那样解读了，但这并不一定是我们实际看到的。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Once Trump realized this was a winning message, then he began to say things that I think were very much against his core belief.
sentences.zh: 一旦特朗普意识到这是一个制胜的信息，他就开始说一些我认为非常违背他核心信念的话。

sentences.en: He began to say, I'm the peace president.
sentences.zh: 他开始说，我是和平总统。

sentences.en: I'll never start wars or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会发动战争或类似的事情。

sentences.en: But, in fact, his core principle was, I believe in myself.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，他的核心原则是，我相信我自己。

sentences.en: And I believe in leverage.
sentences.zh: 我相信杠杆作用。

sentences.en: And I believe in the assertion of power.
sentences.zh: 我相信权力的主张。

sentences.en: And, in fact, I'm even a militaristic person.
sentences.zh: 而且，事实上，我甚至是一个崇尚军事的人。

sentences.en: But you have to know when to use the military.
sentences.zh: 但你必须知道何时使用军队。

sentences.en: You have to know how to use strength.
sentences.zh: 你必须知道如何运用力量。

sentences.en: You have to know, in essence, how to win.
sentences.zh: 本质上，你必须知道如何获胜。

sentences.en: And if there's any ideology to Trump beyond self-belief, it's winning.
sentences.zh: 如果说特朗普除了自我信念之外还有什么意识形态的话，那就是获胜。

sentences.en: Now, what this sounds like is a kind of conflict, two points that are in diametric opposition to each other.
sentences.zh: 现在，这听起来像是一种冲突，两个截然对立的观点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That Trump is, on the one hand, someone saying, no, endless wars.
sentences.zh: 特朗普一方面说，不，不要无休止的战争。

sentences.en: But, on the other hand, saying, I'm a militaristic person.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面又说，我是一个崇尚军事的人。

sentences.en: But whatever conflict those two notions may have presented did not yet reveal themselves in his first term and only came to the surface recently.
sentences.zh: 但无论这两个概念可能呈现出什么冲突，在第一任期内都没有显现出来，直到最近才浮出水面。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning, and he answered.

sentences.en: What do they actually think?
sentences.zh: 他们到底是怎么想的？

sentences.en: What do we know?
sentences.zh: 我们知道什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, one reflection of it is that Republican elected officials, with the exception of two Kentuckyites, Thomas Massey and Rand Paul,
sentences.zh: 嗯，一个反映是，共和党民选官员，除了两位肯塔基人托马斯·马西和兰德·保罗之外，

sentences.en: have been full-throated in their support for Trump.
sentences.zh: 都全力支持特朗普。

sentences.en: They wouldn't be doing that if they believed that there's going to be hell to pay back home.
sentences.zh: 如果他们认为在国内会付出惨重代价，他们就不会这么做了。

sentences.en: And when we look at opinion surveys, they seem by and large to reflect the MAGA coalition being behind Trump and thus behind his work.
sentences.zh: 当我们查看民意调查时，它们似乎在很大程度上反映了 MAGA 联盟支持特朗普，从而支持他的工作。

sentences.en: I've seen another one, however, Natalie, from the Democracy Institute, which is a conservative group.
sentences.zh: 然而，娜塔莉，我看到了另一个来自民主研究所的调查，那是一个保守派团体。

sentences.en: And that poll very clearly shows that Trump is losing young voters.
sentences.zh: 那项民调非常清楚地显示，特朗普正在失去年轻选民。

sentences.en: He's losing black and Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 他正在失去黑人和拉丁裔选民。

sentences.en: And his support amongst independents has utterly collapsed, all due to Iran.
sentences.zh: 他在独立选民中的支持率已经彻底崩溃，这一切都是因为伊朗。

sentences.en: That's interesting because those are the voters he won over.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为那些正是他赢得的选民。

sentences.en: Those were the voters who were so key to getting him elected in 2024.
sentences.zh: 那些选民对他 2024 年当选至关重要。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's completely underwater when it comes to the independents, and he's losing the people who enabled his victory in 2024.
sentences.zh: 在独立选民方面，他的支持率完全跌入谷底，他正在失去那些促成他 2024 年胜利的人。

sentences.en: So what happens to those voters?
sentences.zh: 那么这些选民会怎样？

sentences.en: Do they stay home?
sentences.zh: 他们会待在家里吗？

sentences.en: Do they support Democrats?
sentences.zh: 他们会支持民主党吗？

sentences.en: The question is, will voters trust Democrats, voters who have stayed away from Democrats?
sentences.zh: 问题是，选民会信任民主党吗，那些一直远离民主党的选民？

sentences.en: And will the Democratic brand that has really, really eroded over the last decade somehow manage to be burnished in a way that is sellable to voters?
sentences.zh: 民主党的品牌在过去十年里确实受到了严重侵蚀，它能否以某种方式重塑，使其能够被选民接受？

sentences.en: Will Democrats just content themselves with saying, look at Trump and his stupid war, look at Trump and the cost of gas spiraling,
sentences.zh: 民主党人会满足于仅仅说，看看特朗普和他愚蠢的战争，看看特朗普和飙升的油价，

sentences.en: look at Trump and his intransigence on the Epstein files, when they've yet to come up with their own sort of forward-thinking,
sentences.zh: 看看特朗普在爱泼斯坦文件上的顽固态度，而他们自己还没有提出某种前瞻性的、

sentences.en: positive message that persuades people that maybe Democrats aren't so bad after all?
sentences.zh: 积极的信息来说服人们，也许民主党人毕竟没那么糟糕？

sentences.en: I've yet to see any winning message in that regard, it's just been Trump bad, which may be enough for the 2026 midterms,
sentences.zh: 我还没看到在这方面有什么制胜的信息，一直都只是“特朗普很糟糕”，这对于 2026 年的期中选举可能就足够了。

sentences.en: but it remains to be seen whether or not that's going to be a sellable message two years later.
sentences.zh: 但两年后这套说辞是否还有市场，还有待观察。

sentences.en: What about the Republicans?
sentences.zh: 共和党方面呢？

sentences.en: Because obviously Trump is not going to be around forever.
sentences.zh: 因为很显然，特朗普不可能永远在位。

sentences.en: What do we think the Republican Party will learn from this particular moment of division?
sentences.zh: 我们认为共和党会从这个特殊的时刻学到什么？

sentences.en: Because you can imagine a world in which this war spirals out of control, lasts much longer, and the party concludes, look, we actually do need to lean into isolationism,
sentences.zh: 因为你可以想象这样一种情况：战争失控，持续时间远超预期，党内得出结论说，看吧，我们确实需要倾向于孤立主义，

sentences.en: to the original core principle of no foreign wars.
sentences.zh: 回归不干涉外国战争这一最初的核心原则。

sentences.en: But if the conflict ends relatively soon, with not a lot of American casualties, not a ton more money spent, you could see the party deciding,
sentences.zh: 但如果冲突相对较快结束，美国伤亡不大，也没有额外消耗巨额资金，你可能会看到该党决定，

sentences.en: maybe you can walk this tightrope that Trump is trying to walk.
sentences.zh: 也许特朗普试图走的这条钢丝是可以走通的。

sentences.en: Sure, that's right.
sentences.zh: 确实，没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it's really difficult to tell how it's going to play out.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，真的很难说事情会如何发展。

sentences.en: And you can see that sort of hesitancy, even in the administration, where Marco Rubio, the Secretary of State, who has been alongside Trump, the public face of this war,
sentences.zh: 你可以看到那种犹豫，甚至在政府内部也是如此，比如国务卿马尔科·卢比奥，他一直站在特朗普身边，是这场战争的公众代言人，

sentences.en: and you could see Rubio, I mean, on the one hand, you know, him coming out and saying, look, we did this because we said we could see Israel was going to do it if we didn't.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到卢比奥，我的意思是，一方面，你知道，他出来说，看，我们这样做是因为我们预见到如果我们不采取行动，以色列也会这么做。

sentences.en: And then having to walk it back, in essence, and say, no, no, no, no, I mean, that's not what I was trying to say at all, that he recognizes that, you know,
sentences.zh: 然后又不得不从本质上收回这些话，说，不，不，不，不，我的意思是，那根本不是我想表达的意思，他意识到，你知道，

sentences.en: this war is going to be a difficult thing to explain to voters and a difficult thing to describe as a success.
sentences.zh: 这场战争对选民来说很难解释，也很难将其描述为一场胜利。

sentences.en: While in the meantime, kind of receding from view is the vice president, the seeming heir apparent to Trump, J.D.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，副总统、特朗普看似理所当然的接班人万斯，似乎正在淡出人们的视线，

sentences.en: Vance, who clearly is not the cheerleader in the way that Rubio is.
sentences.zh: 他显然不像卢比奥那样是个啦啦队长。

sentences.en: Yeah, and we've also seen reporting suggesting that Vance pushed back against this Iran plan, but apparently not that much because the Times reported that he also said, well,
sentences.zh: 是的，我们也看到有报道称万斯曾反对这个伊朗计划，但显然反对力度不大，因为《泰晤士报》报道说他也说过，好吧，

sentences.en: if you're going to do it, go big.
sentences.zh: 如果你非要这么做，那就搞大点。

sentences.en: Yeah, and so is he preserving a kind of position of independence in doing that and biding his time basically allowing himself either to pivot into, like,
sentences.zh: 是的，那么他这样做是在保持一种独立立场，并等待时机，基本上是让自己要么转向，比如，

sentences.en: totally supporting a war just as it's ending or being the guy who was exercising notes of concern and caution as the war protracts itself.
sentences.zh: 在战争即将结束时完全支持战争，要么成为那个在战争拖延时表达担忧和谨慎的人。

sentences.en: And for these two figures that you are singling out, Vance, the vice president, the representative of this isolationist wing, and Rubio, who represents the more old-school,
sentences.zh: 对于你提到的这两个人物，代表孤立主义派系的副总统万斯，以及代表该党更老派、

sentences.en: neoconservative side of this party, the difficulty is that the conflict is playing out in real time, and in many ways, their futures, their political futures,
sentences.zh: 新保守主义一面的卢比奥来说，困难在于冲突正在实时上演，在许多方面，他们的未来，他们的政治前途，

sentences.en: and the futures of the party kind of hinge on it.
sentences.zh: 以及该党的未来，都在某种程度上取决于此。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Both Vance and Rubio are trying to preserve their options.
sentences.zh: 万斯和卢比奥都在试图保留他们的选择余地。

sentences.en: They, in essence, have their feet on both sides of the line.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，他们两边都想站。

sentences.en: And in doing that, I mean, what they're really doing, Natalie, is personifying this moment of truth that has arrived for the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 这样做，我的意思是，娜塔莉，他们实际上是在体现共和党现在所面临的这一关键时刻。

sentences.en: It's kind of been sitting there for a while, actually, about, you know, just what they stand for.
sentences.zh: 其实这个时刻已经存在一段时间了，关于，你知道，他们到底代表什么。

sentences.en: There was a bumper sticker, America first, which could be taken literally as stay out of other countries, just do stuff at home.
sentences.zh: 曾经有个保险杠贴纸写着“美国优先”，这可以从字面上理解为远离其他国家，只管国内事务。

sentences.en: And now it's a question of just what is America's role in the world.
sentences.zh: 而现在的问题是，美国在世界上的角色到底是什么。

sentences.en: And nobody really wants to have that conversation.
sentences.zh: 没人真正想进行那场对话。

sentences.en: It's a complicated one.
sentences.zh: 这是一个复杂的问题。

sentences.en: It's a difficult one to sell to voters.
sentences.zh: 向选民推销起来很困难。

sentences.en: But now it feels like the Republican Party almost has no choice but to confront it.
sentences.zh: 但现在感觉共和党几乎别无选择，只能面对它。

sentences.en: As they try to explain to their voters, to Americans, what's this war about?
sentences.zh: 当他们试图向选民、向美国人解释，这场战争是为了什么？

sentences.en: Why are we doing this?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: How is it of value to Americans, considering so many challenges that we have domestically?
sentences.zh: 考虑到我们国内面临的诸多挑战，这对美国人有什么价值？

sentences.en: It feels like a moment where an explanation of what our role in the world is and when we should insert ourself into complicated regions like the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 这感觉是一个时刻，需要解释我们在世界上的角色是什么，以及我们何时应该介入像中东这样复杂的地区。

sentences.en: It's a dialogue begging to be had that has been avoided for years, which now it feels like can't be avoided much longer.
sentences.zh: 这是一场亟待进行的对话，多年来一直被回避，现在感觉再也无法回避了。

sentences.en: Well, Robert, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，罗伯特，非常感谢。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的消息。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, President Trump said that if the Strait of Hormuz, the vital oil shipping route that Iran is blocking, wasn't fully opened by Monday night, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周末，特朗普总统表示，如果伊朗封锁的重要石油运输航线霍尔木兹海峡周一晚间前没有完全开放，美国

sentences.en: would, quote,
sentences.zh: 将，引用原话，

sentences.en: In another sign of how desperate the Trump administration is to get control of the global energy crisis spurred by the war, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普政府为控制战争引发的全球能源危机而感到绝望的又一迹象，美国

sentences.en: temporarily lifted sanctions on some Iranian oil on Friday, though it's unclear how much that move will affect global oil prices.
sentences.zh: 周五暂时解除了对部分伊朗石油的制裁，尽管尚不清楚此举会对全球油价产生多大影响。

sentences.en: And Robert Mueller, the former head of the FBI who became a political target of President Trump, died on Friday at the age of 81.
sentences.zh: 曾成为特朗普总统政治目标的联邦调查局前局长罗伯特·穆勒于周五去世，享年81岁。

sentences.en: On learning of Mueller's death, Trump said in a social media post,
sentences.zh: 在得知穆勒去世的消息后，特朗普在社交媒体上发帖称，

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: I'm glad he's dead.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴他死了。

sentences.en: He can no longer hurt innocent people.
sentences.zh: 他再也不能伤害无辜的人了。

sentences.en: As special counsel investigating Russia's attack on the 2016 presidential election,
sentences.zh: 作为调查俄罗斯干预2016年总统大选的特别检察官，

sentences.en: Mueller concluded that Russia had carried out a systematic effort to interfere in that election,
sentences.zh: 穆勒得出结论，俄罗斯实施了系统性的干预选举行动，

sentences.en: and that the Trump campaign expected it would benefit electorally from that interference.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普竞选团队预计会从这种干预中获得选举利益。

sentences.en: But the investigation didn't find evidence that the Trump campaign had conspired with Russia.
sentences.zh: 但调查没有发现特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯勾结的证据。

sentences.en: And ultimately, Mueller concluded that he could neither absolve nor accuse President Trump of any crime.
sentences.zh: 最终，穆勒得出结论，他既不能免除也不能指控特朗普总统犯有任何罪行。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Ricky Nowetsky, Muj Sadie, Mary Wilson, and Jessica Chung.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由瑞奇·诺维茨基、穆吉·萨迪、玛丽·威尔逊和杰西卡·钟制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett and Rob Zipko, and contains music by Rowan Nemistow.
sentences.zh: 由佩奇·考维特和罗布·齐普科剪辑，包含罗文·内米斯托创作的音乐。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly创作。

sentences.en: This episode was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程师。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们要为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是说他们是不是睡着了就人事不省。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app, or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
